question.question_text: What is the fundamental distinction between "Reinstatement" and "Condonation of Service" under the Nigerian Public Service Rules (PSR)?
question.option_a: Reinstatement applies to officers whose previous service was broken by voluntary resignation, whereas condonation applies to officers whose service was terminated due to disciplinary action.
question.option_b: Reinstatement restores an officer to the same rank and seniority without any break in service following an unlawful dismissal, whereas condonation officially waives a break in service to allow previous and current service records to be merged for pension purposes.
question.option_c: Reinstatement involves the transfer of an officer from one Ministry to another, whereas condonation is the regularization of service for officers who have absconded.
question.option_d: Reinstatement requires the approval of the Head of the Civil Service, whereas condonation requires the approval of the Secretary to the Government of the Federation.
